The near-fold test's precondition was widened from 'persistence < enclosure' (which failed at 1.125 < 0.444 in the reviewed run's exports/gate1.log) to 'persistence < 4.0 * enclosure'; the looser bound no longer establishes that the persistence lies inside the enclosure the read compares against, so the setup check is fragile even though the guard at line 145 is mutation-verified red by exports/negctl_kernel.log.
